question: The average age of 10 students in a class increases by 1 year when a 30-year-old teacher joins them. What was the original average age of the students?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the deviation method for averages:

New person's age = Old average + (Total members × Change in average)

⇒ 30 = Old average + (11 × 1)

⇒ Old average = 30 − 11 = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19 years.**
